name: acad-view
description: Model-space view control for the active AutoCAD document: zoom to an arbitrary drawing-unit rectangle (zoom_window), zoom to drawing extents / limits / named view, zoom by scale factor or around a named center point, and list / activate / describe stored named views. Used as a pre-step for acad.files.export_file scope=Display when the AI agent needs to frame a specific region before capturing a PNG + running describe_image on the result, and as a reset tool between regional captures in multi-tile visual review loops.
intent_examples: center view on a point with height
frame a region of the drawing

tools_summary.name: get_current_view
tools_summary.description: Return the currently active view's center point, width, height and paper-space flag. Use to confirm a zoom actually took effect before capturing.

tools_summary.name: list_views
tools_summary.description: List all named views stored in the drawing's VIEW table with their center point and size. Use to pick a saved architectural view (e.g. "FLOOR-1", "SITE", "DETAIL-A") before capture.

tools_summary.name: set_current_view
tools_summary.description: Restore a named view by name (equivalent to the VIEW _R <name> command). Fails with a clear error if the name doesn't exist in the VIEW table.

tools_summary.name: zoom_all
tools_summary.description: Zoom the active view to the drawing limits + extents (ZOOM _A). Shows every drawing limit rectangle as well as the entity extent.

tools_summary.name: zoom_center
tools_summary.description: Zoom to a specific center point with a requested view height in drawing units (ZOOM _C <center> <height>). Useful to frame a named fixture at a known scale.
intent: center view on a point with height

tools_summary.name: zoom_extents
tools_summary.description: Zoom the active model-space view to fit the bounding box of all entities (ZOOM _E). Use as a reset between regional captures.

tools_summary.name: zoom_scale
tools_summary.description: Zoom the active view by a relative scale factor (ZOOM _S <factor>x). factor>1 zooms in, 0<factor<1 zooms out.

tools_summary.name: zoom_window
tools_summary.description: Zoom the active model-space view to the axis-aligned rectangle defined by two corner points (drawing units). Use before acad.files.export_file scope="Display" to capture a specific region as PNG, or to frame an area for visual inspection. Corners can be in any order; the tool normalises them. This changes what the user sees in AutoCAD and what PlotType.Display would capture.
intent: frame a region of the drawing
